summary: v0.4.1 Phase 5B Pass A (local-only study progress) frontend testing complete. Study Progress panel on /learn renders all 6 stat tiles (Streak, XP, Level, Mastered with Known/Review sub-counts, Due Today, Sessions) plus reset-progress-button with a working native confirm dialog that clears state. Mastery filter row on /learn/cards renders all 6 chips (All, Due Today, New, Review, Known, Mastered) and filters cards correctly. First-time Known mark awards +5 XP toast and shows 'known' badge; first-time Review mark awards +3 XP toast. Anti-farming is honored: after toggling a known card off then remarking known, no additional +5 toast appears (verified programmatically via the awarded flag map in localStorage). Play 3R completes end-to-end (server scoring intact) and shows '+30 XP earned' badge. Test Mode (15Q CLF/SAA) completes end-to-end and shows '+40 XP earned'. Match Mode (5 exercises CLF/SAA) completes end-to-end and shows '+35 XP earned'. Cross-page cf-progress-change sync verified: after marking cards on /learn/cards, navigating back to /learn shows the updated XP/streak/mastered counts without a manual refresh. Voice: Professor -> Calm toggle and Audio: On -> Muted toggle both work without console errors; 34 read-aloud buttons render on flashcards. ONE SPEC DEVIATION found: 'Clicking Known again on a known card promotes it to Mastered' does NOT happen because the toggle-off short-circuit (prev===requested returns 'new') runs BEFORE the promotion branch. See critical_code_review_comments for the exact code path and a one-line fix suggestion.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec says 'Clicking Known again on a known card promotes it to Mastered', but the code's toggle-off short-circuit (if prev===requested) fires first and clears the card back to 'new'. The promote-to-mastered branch (requested==='known' && (prev==='known' || prev==='mastered')) is therefore only reachable when prev==='mastered', which is itself unreachable via UI. Result: users can never reach the 'mastered' state through the Learn Flashcards UI. Verified via UI (clicked mark-known-<id> 4x on the same card; state cycled new -> known -> new -> known -> new, never mastered). Button label logic 'state === known ? Master' is aligned with the spec's intent, so the label 'Master' shown after the 1st click misleads the user.

action_items: Decide the intended Known-again behavior. Two clean options: (a) fix recordCardMark so 'prev==='known' && requested==='known'' promotes to 'mastered' BEFORE the toggle-off short-circuit (matches the spec and the button label 'Master'); or (b) remove the 'Master' button label and update the spec to say 'Click Known again to clear the mark'.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/utils/studyProgress.js recordCardMark: the branch 'if (prev === requested) { p.mastery[cardId] = "new"; ... return cleared }' fires BEFORE the promotion branch 'if (requested === "known" && (prev === "known" || prev === "mastered")) nextState = "mastered"'. Result: the promotion path is dead code from the UI. Suggested fix: move the promotion check ABOVE the toggle-off, e.g. `if (requested === 'known' && (prev === 'known' || prev === 'mastered')) { nextState = 'mastered'; } else if (prev === requested) { return cleared; }`. This preserves anti-farming (awarded key already gates baseXp) while making the Master button reachable.

frontend/src/pages/LearnCards.jsx line ~366: button label uses `state === 'known' ? 'Master'` which visually promises promotion. The label should match actual behavior after the fix above, otherwise it misleads users.

frontend/src/utils/studyProgress.js: markStudyDay() correctly gates once-per-day; sessionsCompleted increments per session; awarded map correctly gates first-time XP for known/review and once-per-day for due bonus. Clean.

frontend/src/pages/Play.jsx line ~87 useEffect on sessionDone awards once per completion via sessionDone dependency. history.length > 0 guard prevents double-award on empty session. Clean.

rca of the issue: recordCardMark toggle-off short-circuit runs before the promotion branch. Concretely, when a user has already marked a card 'known' and clicks the 'Master' button (which sends requested='known'), the check `if (prev === requested)` matches and the function returns with cleared state 'new' before reaching the promotion branch. The promotion branch nextState = 'mastered' is therefore only reachable when prev === 'mastered' (a state the UI cannot itself produce), so it is effectively dead code. Reproduction: 1) fresh localStorage, 2) go /learn/cards, 3) flip card and click mark-known-<id>, 4) click mark-known-<id> again -> observe button label reverts to 'Known' (state=new), NOT 'Mastered'. Expected per spec: state=mastered, badge='mastered', button label='Mastered'. Mitigation: reorder the two checks in recordCardMark so the known-on-known promotion happens first.
